categories.name: Voter ID Services

categories.name: Certificate Services

categories.description: Revenue department land records, Patta transfer, Chitta extracts, A-Register, and FMB sketches.

categories.name: Passport Services

categories.name: Driving Licence / Vehicle Services
categories.description: RTO Learner licence (LLR), Permanent DL, DL renewal, vehicle RC transfer, and fitness certificates.

categories.name: Business Services
categories.description: GST registration, FSSAI Food Licence, Udyam MSME, Shop & Establishment, and Digital Signature (DSC).

services.name: Aadhaar Address Update
services.description: Update your residential address in official UIDAI database with valid proof of address.
services.eligibility: Resident Indian citizen holding a valid 12-digit Aadhaar card with active registered mobile number.
services.processing_info: Request processed by UIDAI backend within 3 to 7 working days. e-Aadhaar downloadable immediately after approval.

services.name: PVC Aadhaar Card Order
services.description: Order durable, waterproof plastic PVC Aadhaar Card with microtext, ghost image, and QR code.
services.processing_info: Printed by Speed Post printing division and delivered directly to registered home address.

services.name: Aadhaar Name & DoB Correction
services.description: Correct typographical errors in Name or Date of Birth in your UIDAI record.
services.eligibility: Allowed only up to 2 times for Name and 1 time for DoB as per UIDAI rules.
services.processing_info: Verified against official Government birth certificate or passport.

services.name: New Aadhaar Enrollment Booking
services.description: Book appointment slot and file initial pre-enrollment for new Aadhaar issuance.
services.eligibility: All Indian residents, infants, and children.
services.processing_info: Biometric capture completed at designated local E-Seva / UIDAI Kendra.

services.name: New PAN Card Application (Form 49A)
services.description: Apply for fresh Permanent Account Number (PAN) for individuals and entities.
services.eligibility: Any Indian citizen, NRI, or entity requiring PAN for financial transactions.
services.processing_info: Physical PAN card dispatched by NSDL/UTIITSL. Instant e-PAN sent to email.

services.name: PAN Card Correction / Update
services.description: Correct details in existing PAN card such as Name, DOB, Father Name, or Photo.
services.processing_info: Reprint with updated info issued by NSDL.

services.name: New Voter Registration (Form 6)
services.description: Enroll as a new voter in the Electoral Roll of Election Commission of India.
services.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 years and above on the qualifying date.
services.processing_info: Field Verification by Booth Level Officer (BLO) followed by Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) approval.

services.name: Voter Address Transfer / Correction (Form 8)
services.description: Shift constituency address or correct voter details in EPIC card.
services.processing_info: Updated EPIC card generated with QR code.

services.name: Income Certificate
services.description: Official revenue document certifying annual family income from all sources.
services.eligibility: Permanent residents of the state requiring income verification for education/subsidies.
services.processing_info: Verified by Village Administrative Officer (VAO) & Revenue Inspector (RI) and issued by Tahsildar.

services.name: Community / Caste Certificate
services.description: Revenue department certificate verifying community / caste category (BC/MBC/SC/ST).
services.eligibility: Residents belonging to recognized state/central community lists.
services.processing_info: Field inquiry by Revenue Inspector & approved by Tahsildar with QR digitally signed certificate.

services.name: Native / Domicile Certificate
services.description: Official proof of continuous residence in the state for education and job quotas.
services.eligibility: Continuous residence for specified statutory period.

services.name: First Graduate Certificate
services.description: Certificate for students who are the first person in their family to pursue graduation (for tuition fee concession).
services.eligibility: No other graduate degree holders in the applicant's immediate family.

services.name: Patta Transfer Application
services.description: Apply for Patta / Chitta ownership name transfer post land purchase or inheritance.
services.eligibility: Property owners with registered sale deed or settlement deed.

services.name: Chitta Extract & FMB Map Download
services.description: Get verified digital copy of Chitta land record and Field Measurement Book (FMB) map.
services.eligibility: Public domain service for land buyers and owners.
services.processing_info: Instant digital extraction from State Land Portal.

services.name: Fresh Passport Application
services.description: Apply for fresh 36 or 60 page Ordinary Indian Passport under Normal scheme.
services.eligibility: Indian citizens with valid identity and address proof.
services.processing_info: Police Verification Report (PVR) followed by Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) appointment.

services.name: Learner Licence (LLR) Booking
services.description: Apply for LLR test for Motorcycle, Light Motor Vehicle (Car) or Commercial category.
services.eligibility: Minimum 16 years for gearless two-wheeler, 18 years for LMV car.
services.processing_info: Computerized RTO test for traffic rules.

services.name: GST Registration Application
services.description: Obtain 15-digit GSTIN for proprietorship, partnership, or private limited business.
services.eligibility: Businesses with turnover exceeding statutory threshold or conducting inter-state supply.

services.name: Electricity Connection (EB) Name Transfer
services.description: Transfer EB service connection meter to new property owner name.
services.eligibility: New property owners with valid registered property document.
services.processing_info: RTI Inspection by TNEB / Electricity Board Engineer.

services.name: Ration Smart Card Add/Remove Member
services.description: Add new born child or newly wed spouse or remove deceased member in Smart Ration Card.
services.eligibility: Existing Smart Ration card head of family.
services.processing_info: Civil Supplies department field inspector check.
